name: Writesonic AI Analytics
description: adds Writesonic AI analytics to improve LLM visibility of your site.
project_description:
The Writesonic AI Analytics Drupal module provides server-side analytics tracking that automatically captures data from all incoming HTTP requests, offering more reliable tracking than client-side solutions like Google Tag Manager. Unlike GTM which relies on JavaScript and can be blocked by ad blockers, this module intercepts requests directly at the server level, ensuring comprehensive data collection including IP addresses, user agents, geographic location, and referrers. The module follows Drupal security best practices with API key authentication and includes smart geo-location detection from multiple header sources.

 Getting Started 
 To get started, enable the module and obtain your API key by visiting our website where you can configure your Drupal site. Once configured through the Drupal admin interface, the module automatically begins tracking all requests while excluding admin paths and static files to maintain clean analytics data and optimal site performance.

 Pledges 
 I pledge to make this module as accessible as it can be. If you find any flaws, please submit an issue here . Help me fix them if you can.
